Ethan: Quick question — my 11/30 paycheck shows CA withholding but I moved to OR on 11/05 and updated HR the same day. Did payroll use the right state?

Rosa (Payroll): Hi Ethan — can you paste the paystub link or payrun id? We'll check the snapshot used for that run.

Ethan: payrun-20231130-05 and paystub: https://files.redwood.internal/paystubs/ethan-1130.png. Net looks ~ $180 less than expected.

Maya (People Ops): FYI I approved Ethan's address change 2023-11-05 10:12 and flagged payroll sync.

Rosa (Payroll): Triage: payroll used HR snapshot from 2023-11-04 during the nightly extract, so the OR update missed the cutoff. Two fixes: 1) reprocess payroll to remove CA withholding retro, and 2) issue an off-cycle net refund for the state tax withheld while reprocess completes. Opening ticket.

PayrollBot: Ticket PR-2023-991 opened. ETA triage 4 business hours. Actions: reprocess payrun, calculate retro tax delta, off-cycle net refund, attach residency memo.

Ethan: Thanks — tight week for cash so off-cycle asap would help.

Rosa (Payroll): We can prioritize. Off-cycle refund scheduled 2023-12-04 EOD (ref OC-9902). Reprocess shows CA withheld $176.42; corrected OR withholding 0. We'll attach a residency memo for audit.

Sam (Tax Ops): Quick note — if CA filings were transmitted for that payroll we may need to amend employer filings or request a reclaim. We'll check submission status and follow up if a W-2C or CA amendment is needed.

Ethan: Off-cycle hit my account today, all good. Thanks everyone.

Maya (People Ops): Follow-up: adding a 3-step move checklist (update HR before payroll cutoff, notify manager, confirm payroll sync) to prevent this. Rosa  can you add pre-payrun validation to flag state mismatches within 7 days of a payrun?

Rosa (Payroll): Yep — creating a validation alert ticket and the one-pager. Closing PR-2023-991. PayrollBot: PR-2023-991 closed by Rosa on 2023-12-04T17:12Z.
